nodes.name: Cu SA Leaching
nodes.procedure: The leaching process is Cu-N4-C ↔ N4-C + Cu2+(aq) + 2e-. Kinetic barrier reduced from 4.74 eV (no H) to 0.70 eV (1H adsorption) and spontaneous (~300 fs) with 2H coadsorption at U_RHE = -1.2 V. Some Cu atoms tethered to surface, some dissolved in aqueous solution.
nodes.source_text: Figure 1b... free energy continues to increase... reaching up to 4.74 eV... Figure 3b... activation energy of 0.70 eV... Figure 3d... Cu SA spontaneously leaches... ~300 fs under 2H coadsorption

nodes.name: H Adsorption on N sites
nodes.procedure: Hydrolysis of H2O at N sites: 4 sequential adsorptions possible. Barriers: 0.64 eV (1st), 0.62 eV (2nd), 0.46 eV (3rd), 0.67 eV (4th). Average barrier ~0.60 eV. ΔG_H becomes negative at negative potentials.
nodes.source_text: Figure 2c,d... energy barrier is 0.64 eV at -1.2 V... activation energies of the remaining three N sites... 0.62, 0.46, and 0.67 eV... average barrier... about 0.60 eV

unit_operations.name: 1st H adsorption
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: hydrolysis of the first H2O to form H* and OH-... energy barrier is 0.64 eV

unit_operations.name: 2nd H adsorption
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: activation energies of the remaining three N sites occupied by H also are calculated, which are 0.62

nodes.name: Cu Cluster Formation
nodes.procedure: Collision and aggregation of tethered Cu atoms and dissolved Cu atoms in aqueous solution forms transient Cu3/4 cluster structure.
nodes.source_text: Figure 3f... the collision of the Cu atoms in the two states forms a transient Cu3/4 cluster structure... the two Cu atoms aggregate is less than 2.5 ps during AIMD

nodes.name: Cu Cluster Reoxidation
nodes.procedure: OH• radicals oxidize Cu4 cluster under positive potential, breaking Cu-Cu bonds and forming oxidized Cu species.
nodes.source_text: Figure 4b... two OH radicals oxidize the first coordination shell of Cu-Cu after 2 and 0.5 ps

nodes.name: Cu Redeposition
nodes.procedure: Oxidized Cu species redeposit onto N4-C sites, reforming Cu-N4-C single atom structure.
nodes.source_text: Figure 4c... Cu redeposition process occurs when Cu(H2O)3 diffuses to the adjacency of the N4-C site, overcoming a kinetic energy barrier of 0.85 eV

nodes.characterization_summary: EXAFS spectra show Cu coordinated with light atoms (C, N, O) during CO2RR, consistent with the final configuration where Cu is coordinated with one N atom and one -OH group.
nodes.evidence_snippet: which is in accordance with the experimental EXAFS spectra data.18

nodes.characterization_summary: XAS characterization confirms structural transformation between atomically dispersed Cu2+ and metallic Cu0 small clusters under operando CO2 electrolysis conditions.
nodes.evidence_snippet: However, the existence of a structural transformation between atomically dispersed Cu+2 and metallic Cu0 small clusters through X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) characterization in operando CO2 electrolysis conditions has indeed been confirmed.
